title: Component composition dependency graph (ADR 0059)
description: Top-down analytical model of how components compose, built by interface commonality before code. Distinct from the code-derived import graph (ADR 0060), which it is reconciled against.

archetype.description: An entry from src/design-system/archetypes.ts, or null when no archetype fits — a human escalation, never an agent default (ADR 0061).

module.description: Repo-relative path to the component module.

composedOf.description: Graph node ids this node is built from (its constituent components).

usedIn.description: Module paths that import this node; reconciled against the dependency-cruiser import graph (ADR 0060) and the source of the API-derivation union (ADR 0062).

compositionSignature.description: v1 = the sorted exact set of composed primitive ids; no subtree topology (ADR 0059). Equal signatures are structural-duplication candidates.
